title: a11y read/inspect improvements for elevated MFC MDI
desc: Gaps in a11y read/inspect on nfrunlite elevated MFC MDI and proposals
steps: [GAP-1 READ-FALLBACK] a11y read on MFC root (_NFHeroMainClass) returns empty - 0 UIA children. Win32 has 16 children. Proposal: if read=0 UIA children AND Win32 child>0, auto-emit inspect hint or run inspect.
[GAP-2 CID-SCOPING] inspect {hwnd:X,cid:Y} ignores cid - dumps root. cid should filter subtree. Workaround: hwnd direct.
[GAP-3 AMBIGUOUS-LIST] {cls:Afx} AMBIGUOUS lists all child hwnd+title. IS MDI enumeration. Expose as --list flag instead of error.
[GAP-4 FORCE-NONTTY] inspect fails user-active-skipping mid-script. --force should auto-apply when stdin not tty.
[GAP-5 CLASSPATH-ELEVATED] cls1/cls2 silent-empty for elevated MDI. Needs Win32 hwnd-chain fallback.
[WORKAROUND] 1. {cls:Afx} AMBIGUOUS=hwnd list. 2. {hwnd:X} --force=child inspect. 3. {hwnd:X} --force on Document cid=Value read.

FIXED 2026-05-18: a11y read CDP path (A11yReadBrowserFirst in A11yCommand.Cdp.cs) now waits for SPA hydration before returning. Sequence: WaitForLoadAsync(2s) + CdpReadSettle(2.5s idle-settle polling body.innerText growth) + 3x retry if result < 200 chars (skeleton threshold). Affects YouTube, Twitter, Gmail -- any SPA that renders skeleton HTML first. Commit: see A11yCommand.Cdp.cs lines 688-880.

requirements.expect: empty (0 UIA children on MFC root)
no fallback hint triggered (UIA children present, Win32>0 AND UIA=0 condition not met)
